title: Off-planet pin given at Cape Canaveral

tellings.quote: Well, uh that pen was given to me by uh someone everybody has read about right down at Cape Canaveral without saying names.

plain: Sometime between 2007 and 2010, at Cape Canaveral, the Florida rocket launch site, a famous person whom "everybody has read about" gave Chris Bledsoe a pin described as having come from off the planet. Bledsoe, a man NASA has studied because he says he attracts UFOs, tells this himself and declines to name the giver, though the story's notes link it to a man named Timothy Taylor. He tells it as a sign of quiet contact with people inside the space world.
